puppies.name: Brandy
puppies.description: Meet Brandy! This precious little Yorkie girl was born September 7th, 2026. Her mom is Black Velvet and her dad is Capri, and she is a littermate of Brady and Bowie. Brandy has the classic Baby Doll Face, a rich black and tan coat, and the sweetest little personality. She is ready to steal your heart!

puppies.name: Brady
puppies.description: Meet Brady! This handsome baby boy was born September 7th, 2026. His mom is Black Velvet and his dad is Capri, and he is a littermate of Brandy and Bowie. Brady has a gorgeous black and tan coat, a sweet teddy bear face, and plenty of puppy charm. He is ready to be someone's best buddy!

puppies.name: Bowie
puppies.description: Meet Bowie! This adorable Yorkie baby was born September 7th, 2026. Bowie's mom is Black Velvet and dad is Capri, and Bowie is a littermate of Brandy and Brady. With a darling Baby Doll Face, bright eyes, and a soft black and tan coat, Bowie is pure sweetness and ready for a loving forever home.
